name: fixer-backend

scripts.//test:parity: Needs the real library.db, passed via LIBRARY_DB. Reads only, so it cannot modify the catalog.
scripts.//test:model-parity: Needs models installed in models/ (scripts/app-models/export_onnx.py at the repo root).

//dependencies: onnxruntime-node is pinned to the exact version @huggingface/transformers pins, so npm dedupes it to ONE native binding. Bump both together.
//overrides: sharp must resolve to ONE copy. @huggingface/transformers depends on sharp ^0.34.5 and bundles its own @img/sharp-libvips; installing a newer sharp alongside it loads two libvips into the process, which macOS reports as duplicate Objective-C classes and warns 'may cause spurious casting failures and mysterious crashes'. Keep this override in step with the transformers dependency when upgrading, and re-run the imaging and parity tests afterwards.
